rawContent:
Fantastic to hear @jessewente on @metromorning frame exactly why @GretaThunberg is so powerful.
And lovely to hear that Greta was joined in NY by Indigenous youth who are disproportionately impacted by #climatechange (nice shout out to Autumn Peltier, now heading to the UN).

Glad to hear so many people are asking about the other voices of #climatestrike #FridaysForFuture because Indigenous voices have traditionally not been listened to here though they’ve been the strongest, most connected, most affected by #climatechange @metromorning

@fdk_donnaindra Agreed. I was inspired to hear @Rileyyesnomaybe on @CBCSunday addressing this; we have a perspective gap between our communities (Indigenous people of many different nations here and settler/immigrant/Canadians) - we don’t sense the urgency #ClimateChange
https://t.co/mwGCZZzsaq

“Machine of colonialism eats us up and chews us out - all of us, regardless of background”. 
Right?  #ClimateChange #truthbeforereconciliation 
Thank you - didn’t catch name but appreciate the conversation.
